description: Alterations at roof level, involving insertion of roof access rooflight for maintenance purposes only, relocation of 2 x existing front rooflights, insertion of 1 x flue outlet and 2 x extract ducts to flat roof, replacement of asphalt surface to central flat roof area with new waterproofing system, and replacement of fibre cement artificial slates on front roof with natural slate.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: (2GARD-)001 Rev P1 , 002 Rev P1 , 004 Rev P1, 005 Rev P1, 020 Rev P1, 021 Rev P1, 030 Rev P1, 031 Rev P1, 101 Rev P1, 102 Rev P1, 200 Rev P1, 201 Rev P1, 300 Rev P1, 301 Rev P1; Planning and Heritage Statement from CS Planning dated 02/04/2026; Manufacturer's product specification (roof slate) & sample photograph.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017, and policies DH1 and DH2 of the Hampstead Neighbourhood Plan 2018.
Condition : 4 - The approved roof access rooflight shall only be used during periods when 
works associated with cleaning, repairs and/or maintenance are taking place at roof level at the application site and should at all other times remain closed shut.
 
Reason:  In order to safeguard the amenities of the neighbouring occupiers in accordance with the requirements of policy A1 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and policy DH1 of the Hampstead Neighbourhood Plan 2018.
Condition : 5 - No part of the roof area shall be used as a roof terrace, sitting out area or other amenity space.

Reason:  In order to safeguard the amenities of the neighbouring occupiers in accordance with the requirements of policy A1 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and policy DH1 of the Hampstead Neighbourhood Plan 2018.
